title: hive-rule amend: request body
description: Appends an attributed amendment to a rule: an extension, an early end, a lift honoured by its named receipt, or a note. The original words and dates stay; the rule's status and the time the resolver uses change. A supersession is not an amendment: it is the changes of the superseding rule, read at each resolution. The envelope's expected_revisions names the rule's revision and its authority is the amendment's.

evidence.description: For a lift: the receipt that meets the lift condition, which must be of the kind and about the subject the condition names.
